Rows.After: Single direct contract case plus feature regressions; complete error/options and OTP differential verification pending Already-connected guest remote PID LINK output is accepted into finite connection-owned staging before the normal caller waits. Captured-generation LINK, local relation and local receiver priority commit together after actual encoding/capacity preflight. An accepted worker retains its ticket and entry lease across producer cancellation or kill; retained terminal EXIT follows LINK in order. Normal callers cooperatively admit existing owner signals/system queries while awaiting turn or capacity. With async_dist true the caller returns after bounded acceptance without that output wait. Duplicate LINK remains idempotent, link/2 options validate before mutation, and hard staging-cap refusal raises system_limit before relation installation. SDK staging and transport have separately finite accounted-byte/packet budgets; these are SDK resource bounds, not physical native buffer sizes. Accepted UNLINK remains connection-owned and only its guest wait admits caller signals. Pending/autoconnect, remote names/aliases, synchronous embedding setters, complete inbound priority, live SDK network peers, native scheduler/queue-phase identity and general native wire equality remain incomplete. Five actual generated-guest HOST controls cover normal/async turn/capacity ownership and hard-cap refusal. The separate pinned original325 collector remains unexecuted by this pipeline.
